1. export type Prop<T = any> =
2.   | {
3.       // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-types
4.       new (...args: any[]): T & object
5.     }
6.   | {
7.       (): T
8.     }
9.   | PropMethod<T>
10. 
11. type PropMethod<T, TConstructor = any> = T extends (...args: any) => any
12.   ? {
13.       new (): TConstructor
14.       (): T
15.       readonly prototype: TConstructor
16.     }
17.   : never
18. 
19. // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-types
20. export type NativeType = string | boolean | number | null | undefined | Function
21. 
22. export type Constructor = new (...args: any[]) => any
23. 
24. export type PropType<T> = Prop<T> | Prop<T>[]
25. 
26. export interface PropOptions<T = any, D = T> {
27.   type?: PropType<T> | true | null
28.   required?: boolean
29.   default?:
30.     | D
31.     | null
32.     | undefined
33.     | (() => D | null | undefined)
34.     | ((props: Record<string, unknown>) => D)
35.     // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-types
36.     | object
37.   validator?(value: T): boolean
38. }
39. 
40. // see https://github.com/vuejs/vue-next/blob/22717772dd83b67ffaa6ad9805c6269e184c7e41/packages/runtime-core/src/componentProps.ts#L67
41. export type InferType<T> = T extends { type: null | true }
42.   ? any
43.   : T extends ObjectConstructor | { type: ObjectConstructor }
44.   ? { [key: string]: any }
45.   : T extends Prop<infer V>
46.   ? V
47.   : T extends PropOptions<infer V>
48.   ? V
49.   : T extends VueTypeDef<infer V>
50.   ? V
51.   : T extends VueTypeValidableDef<infer V>
52.   ? V
53.   : T
54. 
55. export type ValidatorFunction<T> = (value: T) => boolean
56. 
57. export type DefaultFactory<T> = (() => T) | T
58. 
59. export type DefaultType<T> = T extends NativeType ? T : DefaultFactory<T>
60. 
61. export interface VueTypeBaseDef<
62.   T = unknown,
63.   D = DefaultType<T>,
64.   U = T extends NativeType ? T : () => T,
65. > extends PropOptions<T> {
66.   _vueTypes_name: string
67.   type?: PropType<T> | null
68.   readonly def: (def?: D) => this & {
69.     default: U
70.   }
71.   readonly isRequired: this & { required: true }
72. }
73. 
74. export type VueTypeDef<T = unknown> = VueTypeBaseDef<T>
75. 
76. export interface VueTypeValidableDef<T = unknown> extends VueTypeBaseDef<T> {
77.   readonly validate: (
78.     fn: ValidatorFunction<T | unknown>,
79.   ) => this & { validator: ValidatorFunction<T | unknown> }
80. }
81. 
82. export type VueProp<T> = VueTypeBaseDef<T> | PropOptions<T>
83. 
84. export interface VueTypeShape<T>
85.   extends VueTypeBaseDef<T, DefaultType<Partial<T>>, () => Partial<T>> {
86.   readonly loose: VueTypeLooseShape<T>
87. }
88. 
89. export interface VueTypeLooseShape<T>
90.   extends VueTypeBaseDef<
91.     T,
92.     DefaultFactory<Partial<T & { [key: string]: any }>>,
93.     () => Partial<T> & { [key: string]: any }
94.   > {
95.   readonly loose: VueTypeLooseShape<T>
96.   readonly _vueTypes_isLoose: true
97. }
98. 
99. export interface VueTypesDefaults {
100.   func: (...args: any[]) => any
101.   bool: boolean
102.   string: string
103.   number: number
104.   array: () => any[]
105.   object: () => { [key: string]: any }
106.   integer: number
107. }
108. 
109. export interface ExtendProps<T = any> {
110.   name: string
111.   getter?: boolean
112.   validate?: boolean
113.   type?: PropType<T> | VueTypeDef<T> | VueTypeValidableDef<T>
114.   required?: boolean
115.   default?: T | null | undefined | (() => T | null | undefined)
116.   validator?(...args: any[]): boolean
117. }

20. ): string {

22.   if (type) {

30.   if (value === null || value === undefined) return ''
31.   const match = value.constructor.toString().match(FN_MATCH_REGEXP)

173.   value: U,

203.       expectedType = getType(typeToCheck)

207.       } else if (expectedType === 'Object') {

264.       writable: true,

343. /**
344.  * Return a new VueTypes type using another type as base.
345.  *
346.  * Properties in the `props` object will overwrite those defined in the source one
347.  * expect for the `validator` function. In that case both functions will be executed in series.
348.  *
349.  * @param name - Name of the new type
350.  * @param source - Source type
351.  * @param props - Custom type properties
352.  */
353. export function fromType<T extends VueTypeDef<any>>(name: string, source: T): T
354. export function fromType<
355.   T extends VueTypeDef<any>,
356.   V extends PropOptions<InferType<T>>,
357. >(name: string, source: T, props: V): Omit<T, keyof V> & V
358. export function fromType<
359.   T extends VueTypeDef<any>,
360.   V extends PropOptions<InferType<T>>,
361. >(name: string, source: T, props?: V) {
362.   // 1. create an exact copy of the source type
363.   const copy = clone(source)
364. 
365.   // 2. give it a new name
366.   copy._vueTypes_name = name
367. 
368.   if (!isPlainObject(props)) {
369.     return copy
370.   }
371.   const { validator, ...rest } = props
372. 
373.   // 3. compose the validator function
374.   // with the one on the source (if present)
375.   // and ensure it is bound to the copy
376.   if (isFunction(validator)) {
377.     let { validator: prevValidator } = copy
378. 
379.     if (prevValidator) {
380.       prevValidator = unwrap(prevValidator)
381.     }
382. 
383.     copy.validator = bindTo(
384.       prevValidator
385.         ? function (this: T, value: any) {
386.             return (
387.               prevValidator.call(this, value) && validator.call(this, value)
388.             )
389.           }
390.         : validator,
391.       copy,
392.     )
393.   }
394.   // 4. overwrite the rest, if present
395.   return Object.assign(copy, rest as V)
396. }

399.   return string.replace(/^(?!\s*$)/gm, '  ')

1. import { Prop, VueProp, VueTypeShape, VueTypeLooseShape } from '../types'
2. import { toType, validateType, warn, isPlainObject, indent } from '../utils'
3. 
4. // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-types
5. export default function shape<T extends object>(
6.   obj: { [K in keyof T]: Prop<T[K]> | VueProp<T[K]> },
7. ): VueTypeShape<T> {
8.   const keys = Object.keys(obj)
9.   const requiredKeys = keys.filter((key) => !!(obj as any)[key]?.required)
10. 
11.   const type = toType('shape', {
12.     type: Object,
13.     validator(this: VueTypeShape<T> | VueTypeLooseShape<T>, value) {
14.       if (!isPlainObject(value)) {
15.         return false
16.       }
17.       const valueKeys = Object.keys(value)
18. 
19.       // check for required keys (if any)
20.       if (
21.         requiredKeys.length > 0 &&
22.         requiredKeys.some((req) => valueKeys.indexOf(req) === -1)
23.       ) {
24.         const missing = requiredKeys.filter(
25.           (req) => valueKeys.indexOf(req) === -1,
26.         )
27.         if (missing.length === 1) {
28.           warn(`shape - required property "${missing[0]}" is not defined.`)
29.         } else {
30.           warn(
31.             `shape - required properties "${missing.join(
32.               '", "',
33.             )}" are not defined.`,
34.           )
35.         }
36. 
37.         return false
38.       }
39. 
40.       return valueKeys.every((key) => {
41.         if (keys.indexOf(key) === -1) {
42.           if ((this as VueTypeLooseShape<T>)._vueTypes_isLoose === true)
43.             return true
44.           warn(
45.             `shape - shape definition does not include a "${key}" property. Allowed keys: "${keys.join(
46.               '", "',
47.             )}".`,
48.           )
49.           return false
50.         }
51.         const type = (obj as any)[key]
52.         const valid = validateType(type, value[key], true)
53.         if (typeof valid === 'string') {
54.           warn(`shape - "${key}" property validation error:\n ${indent(valid)}`)
55.         }
56.         return valid === true
57.       })
58.     },
59.   }) as VueTypeShape<T>
60. 
61.   Object.defineProperty(type, '_vueTypes_isLoose', {
62.     writable: true,
63.     value: false,
64.   })
65. 
66.   Object.defineProperty(type, 'loose', {
67.     get() {
68.       this._vueTypes_isLoose = true
69.       return this
70.     },
71.   })
72. 
73.   return type
74. }
75.

1. import { Prop, VueProp, InferType, PropType } from '../types'
2. import {
3.   isArray,
4.   isComplexType,
5.   isVueTypeDef,
6.   isFunction,
7.   toType,
8.   validateType,
9.   warn,
10.   indent,
11. } from '../utils'
12. 
13. export default function oneOfType<
14.   U extends VueProp<any> | Prop<any>,
15.   V = InferType<U>,
16. >(arr: U[]) {
17.   if (!isArray(arr)) {
18.     throw new TypeError(
19.       '[VueTypes error]: You must provide an array as argument',
20.     )
21.   }
22. 
23.   let hasCustomValidators = false
24. 
25.   let nativeChecks: Prop<V>[] = []
26. 
27.   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
28.     const type = arr[i]
29.     if (isComplexType<V>(type)) {
30.       if (
31.         isVueTypeDef<V>(type) &&
32.         type._vueTypes_name === 'oneOf' &&
33.         type.type
34.       ) {
35.         nativeChecks = nativeChecks.concat(type.type as PropType<V>)
36.         continue
37.       }
38.       if (isFunction(type.validator)) {
39.         hasCustomValidators = true
40.       }
41.       if (type.type !== true && type.type) {
42.         nativeChecks = nativeChecks.concat(type.type)
43.         continue
44.       }
45.     }
46.     nativeChecks.push(type as Prop<V>)
47.   }
48. 
49.   // filter duplicates
50.   nativeChecks = nativeChecks.filter((t, i) => nativeChecks.indexOf(t) === i)
51. 
52.   if (!hasCustomValidators) {
53.     // we got just native objects (ie: Array, Object)
54.     // delegate to Vue native prop check
55.     return toType<V>('oneOfType', {
56.       type: nativeChecks,
57.     })
58.   }
59. 
60.   return toType<V>('oneOfType', {
61.     type: nativeChecks,
62.     validator(value) {
63.       const err: string[] = []
64.       const valid = arr.some((type) => {
65.         const t =
66.           isVueTypeDef(type) && type._vueTypes_name === 'oneOf'
67.             ? type.type || null
68.             : type
69.         const res = validateType(t, value, true)
70.         if (typeof res === 'string') {
71.           err.push(res)
72.         }
73.         return res === true
74.       })
75.       if (!valid) {
76.         warn(
77.           `oneOfType - provided value does not match any of the ${
78.             err.length
79.           } passed-in validators:\n${indent(err.join('\n'))}`,
80.         )
81.       }
82. 
83.       return valid
84.     },
85.   })
86. }
